responsibility: This header collects cross-file declarations for the PRU backend. It exposes shared target data structures such as pru_ctable_entry and pru_byterange, the global CTABLE state, and the public target helpers for frame elimination, prologue/epilogue expansion, compare and doloop expansion, CTABLE decoding, I/O-register mapping, pragma/pass registration, and return-in-memory decisions that are implemented in pru.cc and used by the md-generated code and support files.
